verdict.rationale: Datalab clearly lets you evaluate on your own data before committing: a free monthly allowance is 'enough to run a full proof of concept on your own documents', and Forge needs no API key. Published benchmarks are evidenced only indirectly, through community references to Marker's own benchmark and GitHub comparison chart; one user suspects an error in that chart's speed figures. Missing for 10: first-party benchmark documentation in the pack, evidence that the benchmarks are reproducible (published datasets, scripts or methodology), and independent corroboration of the accuracy numbers.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, the vendor publishes reproducible accuracy benchmarks and I can run my own evals before committing
